description:
The terminal fits above a tall phone keyboard (xterm). Terminals render with xterm. "The panel" is ".terminal-panel" and "the screen" is the visible ".xterm-screen" inside the panel (the first one with a nonzero box). The viewport starts at 393x851.
1. Navigate to /new and open the Terminal workspace tool: phones keep workspace tools in the overflow menu, so click the visible button with aria-label exactly "More options", then the button in ".chat-overflow-popover" whose text starts with "Terminal".
2. The screen should be visible. Record the panel's getBoundingClientRect().height in a window variable as its original height.
3. Android's resizes-content viewport policy makes a tall keyboard (or landscape) reduce the layout viewport; the grid and its input must remain reachable. Set the viewport to 393x320. Then this should become true (eval with expect, within 5s): the screen's getBoundingClientRect() has top >= 0 and top + height <= 320, and [data-testid="message-input"]'s top + height <= 320.
4. They must recover their chosen height on dismissal: set the viewport to 393x851. The panel's height should become exactly the original height.
5. Click the button with aria-label exactly "Close active terminal".

steps.expression: (() => { const screen = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.terminal-panel .xterm-screen')).find(el => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0; }); const sr = screen.getBoundingClientRect(); const ir = document.querySelector('[data-testid="message-input"]').getBoundingClientRect(); return sr.top >= 0 && sr.top + sr.height <= 320 && ir.top + ir.height <= 320; })()
